questions.prompt: If I had taken that job in Denver, I ___ there now.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is a correct mixed conditional?

options.text: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor today.
If I studied medicine, I would have been a doctor today.
If I had studied medicine, I will be a doctor today.

questions.explanation: Had + past participle (past) pairs with would + base verb for a present result (today).

questions.prompt: "If they hadn't missed the flight, they would be on the beach now." What is true?

options.text: They missed the flight and they aren't on the beach.
They caught the flight and they're on the beach.
They will miss the flight tomorrow.

questions.explanation: Conditionals describe the opposite of reality: they did miss the flight, so they aren't on the beach now.
